name: Andrew Smith
story: Andrew Smith is acknowledged for the Wellington Regional Council wildfire study and digital data supplied to a Chilton Saint James School vegetation-fire project. The February 2001 Fire Service report documents council GIS data being reused in school fieldwork and fire-hazard analysis.

sources.label: New Zealand Fire Service Commission Research Report No.10, A Pilot Study to Identify Strategies to Assess Vegetation Fire Hazards, Chilton Saint James School
